arguments.command: ls tests | head -50; ls; cat TESTING.md 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i "pytest\|run" | head -20
find tests -type f | grep -v fixtures/ | head -50; find tests -type f | wc -l; grep -n -A15 "FAST\|## 3" CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | grep -i tests | head
find tests -type f | head -50; grep -rn "tests/" CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | head -20
ls -la tests/ tests/_shared tests/_ref 2>&1 | head -40; ls -la _shared 2>&1 | head

grep -rln "tests/fixtures\|plan-relations" --include=*.py --include=*.sh --include=*.rs . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; echo ---; uv run _shared/test_doc_lint.py > /tmp/doclint.out 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; tail -30 /tmp/doclint.out
